snippet.title: Developer Update | Season 19: Haunted Masquerade, Stadium, Mythics, & More
snippet.description:
The team has a few tricks and treats up their sleeves as Season 19 quickly approaches.

Join Associate Game Director Alec Dawson as he breaks down our newest Halloween game mode, Haunted Masquerade, and some of the upcoming balance changes coming to Perks.

After that, Senior Systems Designer Scott Hwang walks us through some of the new additions to Stadium like the arrival of Sojourn, Torbjörn, and Hazard, and the introduction of our new active items called Gadgets.

Game Producer Ren Soanes gives us a closer look at the Lifeweaver Mythic Hero Skin and Kiriko Mythic Weapon Skin, both arriving at launch, and the new Junkrat Mythic Hero Skin that arrives during midseason.

And Narrative Lead Miranda Moyer wraps things up with a look at how you’ll be able to view Overwatch stories in-game, and shares her excitement for our Hero 45 Gameplay Trial coming later in the season.

Enjoy all this and more when Season 19: Haunted Masquerade starts on Oct 14!

Overwatch 2 is free to play for everyone on console & PC!
_
